rows.reply: Aarav, cricket pitch par tiles ki rows socho: pehli row mein 1, phir 3, phir 6 tiles. Agli row mein kitni hongi? Bittu ko bhi sikhaoge.
Aarav, odd sequence mein numbers 2-2 badhte hain: 1, 3, 5, 7. Even sequence bhi 2-2 badhti hai: 2, 4, 6, 8. Agla odd number kya hoga?
Aarav, triangular numbers mein har baar agli ginti jodte hain: 1, phir 2, phir 3. Isliye 1, 3, 6, 10, 15. 6th number?
Aarav, 7th triangular number nikalne ke liye 6th number 21 mein 7 jodo. Ab 21 plus 7 kitna hoga?
Aarav, ab practice: 11 ke baad agle do odd numbers kaun se hain? Apna try batao.

rows.said: Mujhe nahi pata, ek baar aur batao na.
rows.heard: मुझे नहीं पता। एक बार और बताओ ना।
rows.reply: Aarav, odd numbers 2-2 badhte hain. 11 ke baad pehle 11 mein 2 jodo, phir us result mein 2 jodo—try karo.

rows.heard: मुझे लगता है तेरह और पंद्रह.
rows.reply: Bilkul, Aarav—tumne 11 mein 2 jodkar 13, phir 13 mein 2 jodkar 15 nikala. Ab 15 ke baad agla odd number kya hoga?
Aarav, 15 ke baad bhi 2 jodenge, isliye agla odd number 17 hoga. Ab 11, 13, 15, 17 ka rule batao. Ravi kehta hai: 'Sequence 1, 4 se shuru hota hai, toh agla number 7 hi hoga.' Kya woh sahi hai?

rows.said: Yes, after 1, 4 the next number is always 7?
rows.heard: Yes, after one, four, the next number is always seven.
rows.reply: Aarav, sirf 1 aur 4 dekhkar rule pakka nahi hota. Socho: 1, 4, 7 aur 1, 4, 9 dono possible hain. Ravi sahi hai?
